observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a full-black solar panel (black cells, black frame) standing upright outdoors on bare ground against a wall, with other panels leaning in the background.
No visible manufacturer label, model number, wattage sticker, or junction box on the panel in either photo.
Watermark text 'Innoson Global Group' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is a listing-platform/reseller watermark, not a manufacturer marking on the panel itself.
Panel surface shows reflections/glare obscuring parts of the cell surface, so hairline cracks or micro-damage cannot be ruled out.
No scale reference, no backside shot, no connector/cable shot, no multimeter or output test shown.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium&Tubular Batteries, Charge...
claims.evidence: General ad text covering multiple product lines; no photo ties 'high quality' to this specific panel's specs or performance.

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating unknown, which is the primary price driver for a solar panel
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate sticker showing wattage, voltage, and model
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since worst-case price band is undefined

risks.risk: Panel could be used/refurbished rather than new despite 'high quality' claim
risks.proof: Close-up of frame corners and junction box for wear, plus any manufacture date sticker

risks.risk: Hidden micro-cracks or cell damage obscured by glare in photos
risks.proof: Photo taken at an angle without glare, or an electroluminescence/flash test clip
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible cell damage

risks.risk: Output not verified; panel could be dead or underperforming
risks.proof: Video of panel connected to a multimeter in sunlight showing voltage/current

risks.risk: Connectors/cables could be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the junction box and MC4 connectors on the rear

proof_requests: Close-up of the rear nameplate sticker (wattage, voltage, model, serial)
Photo or video of the panel's backside showing junction box and connectors
Multimeter test video in daylight showing open-circuit voltage/current
Clear glare-free photo of the full cell surface for crack inspection
response.reason: The panel's wattage/model, which sets even a worst-case price band for a solar panel, is not readable in either photo and no nameplate is shown.
